# innostes UI

> A production-grade design system and React component library engineered for enterprise ERP, HRMS, and CRM platforms. Accessible, WCAG 2.2 AA compliant, and localized.

## Core Documentation
- [Accessibility Statement](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/accessibility): WCAG 2.2 Level AA conformance, component guarantees, developer responsibilities, and assistive technology testing.
- [Colour](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/colour): OKLCH semantic palette, contrast tokens, functional roles, and verified WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios.
- [Dark Mode](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/dark-mode): Implement dark mode across applications using class-based or data-attribute activation, next-themes, and hydration safeguards.
- [Icons](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/icons): Iconography standards, Lucide React integration, sizing rules inside components, and accessibility requirements.
- [Motion](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/motion): Transition durations, easing curves, and prefers-reduced-motion accessibility standards.
- [Spacing and Layout](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/spacing): 4px base spatial rhythm, density modes, container queries, and responsive layout primitives.
- [Status legend](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/status-legend): Stability tiers and readiness criteria for components in @innostes/ui.
- [Typography](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/foundations/typography): Typography scale, fluid type tokens, font stacks, and tabular numeric rules for enterprise ERP interfaces.
- [Next.js App Router](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/frameworks/nextjs): Complete integration guide for Next.js App Router, Server Components, dark mode with next-themes, and styling.
- [Vite React](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/frameworks/vite): Complete integration guide for Vite React projects with Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, and dark mode.
- [Introduction](https://innostes.com/ui/docs): Enterprise UI component library for ERP and operations systems, built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS.
- [Installation](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/installation): Install @innostes/ui, configure stylesheets, set up providers, and verify your build.
- [Application shell](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/app-shell): Composable layout scaffolding for multi-tenant enterprise dashboards.
- [Complex forms](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/complex-forms): Architecture for multi-section data entry, validation, and unsaved changes.
- [Data management](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/data-management): Patterns for enterprise data tables, batch actions, and filtering.
- [Patterns](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/patterns/index): Reusable composition recipes for enterprise application architectures.
- [Theming & Design Tokens](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/theming): Semantic design token architecture, OKLCH colour system, theme overrides, multi-tenant scoping, and generated token reference.

## Components
- [Button Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/button-group) [Stable]: Merges borders and corners of adjacent buttons, horizontally or vertically.
- [Button](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/button) [Stable]: A flexible button component with multiple variants, sizes, and states.
- [Actions](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/index) [Stable]: Core interactive controls for submitting forms, triggering commands, and toggling states.
- [Toggle Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/toggle-group) [Stable]: Single or multiple selection with roving focus and arrow-key navigation.
- [Toggle](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/actions/toggle) [Stable]: Two-state button for formatting, favourites and view options.
- [Avatar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/avatar) [Stable]: Image with initials fallback, four sizes, round or square, and stacked groups.
- [Badge](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/badge) [Stable]: Semantic colours for statuses, with an optional dot.
- [Card](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/card) [Stable]: Header with title, description and actions, plus content and footer areas.
- [Data Table](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/data-table) [Beta]: Sorting, row selection, pagination, loading and empty states. Client-side or server-side.
- [Empty State](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/empty-state) [Stable]: Icon, title, explanation and next actions for empty lists and searches.
- [Icon Tile](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/icon-tile) [Stable]: 14 colours, soft or solid, four sizes. Used by metric cards, lists and feature grids.
- [Data display](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/index) [Stable]: Components for structured record presentation, hierarchies, and metric highlights.
- [Kbd](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/kbd) [Stable]: For shortcuts in tooltips, menus and help text.
- [Stat](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/stat) [Stable]: Label, value and trend, with colours that know whether "up" is good.
- [Table](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/table) [Stable]: Native table markup with consistent spacing, hover and selected rows, and horizontal scrolling.
- [Tree View](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/data-display/tree-view) [Beta]: Departments, chart of accounts, categories and folders, with full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard support.
- [Alert](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/alert) [Stable]: Info, success, warning and error messages with matching icons and live-region roles.
- [Gauge](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/gauge) [Beta]: KPI dials for budget use, capacity, SLA and quota, with value-based colours.
- [Feedback](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/index) [Stable]: Components for communicating system status, background task progress, and operation outcomes.
- [Meter](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/meter) [Stable]: Storage, seats or quota usage, with tone colours for limits.
- [Progress](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/progress) [Stable]: Determinate and indeterminate bars with an optional label and value.
- [Skeleton](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/skeleton) [Stable]: Pulsing shapes sized with utility classes. Respects reduced motion.
- [Spinner](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/spinner) [Stable]: Inherits the text colour; sized with utility classes.
- [Toast](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/feedback/toast) [Stable]: Success, error, warning, loading and promise toasts with actions, swipe to dismiss and a queue limit.
- [Calendar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/calendar) [Stable]: Single and range modes, min/max and disabled days, one or two months, locale-aware, fully keyboard accessible.
- [Checkbox](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/checkbox) [Stable]: Single checkboxes and groups with a "select all" parent.
- [Combobox](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox) [Beta]: Type to filter, arrow keys to move, Enter to pick. For long lists like countries or customers.
- [Date Picker](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/date-picker) [Stable]: DatePicker and DateRangePicker with presets, min/max, clearing, and plain-form submission.
- [Field & Form](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/field) [Stable]: Accessible wiring between label, control, help text and errors, with native and custom validation.
- [File Dropzone](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/file-dropzone) [Beta]: Type, size and count checks, image thumbnails, and native form submission.
- [Forms](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/index) [Stable]: Input fields, pickers, validation containers, and specialised editors for complex data entry.
- [Input Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/input-group) [Stable]: InputGroup, SearchInput (clear, Escape, shortcut hint) and PasswordInput (show/hide).
- [Input](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/input) [Stable]: Three sizes, invalid and disabled states, file inputs, and automatic Field wiring.
- [Locale Selects](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/locale-select) [Stable]: Names come from the browser's Intl API in the user's language. No data files to bundle or update.
- [Number Field](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/number-field) [Stable]: Min/max clamping, keyboard and wheel stepping, currency and percent formats.
- [Radio Group](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group) [Stable]: Arrow-key navigation, form submission and Field support.
- [Rich Text Editor](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/rich-text-editor) [Beta]: Bold, headings, lists, quotes, links and undo, with Markdown shortcuts. Built on Tiptap, in a separate entry point.
- [Searchable Select](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select) [Stable]: For long lists of simple options. Matches labels and keywords, accent-insensitive.
- [Select](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/select) [Stable]: Groups, separators, multiple selection, type-ahead and form submission.
- [Slider](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/slider) [Stable]: Single values and ranges, keyboard support, form submission.
- [Switch](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/switch) [Stable]: Two sizes, form submission and Field support.
- [Tag Input](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/tag-input) [Beta]: Labels, skills, recipients and SKUs as chips, with suggestions, paste splitting, limits and validation.
- [Textarea](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/textarea) [Stable]: Optional auto-resize, and automatic Field wiring.
- [App Rail](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/app-rail) [Stable]: Used alongside a sidebar to navigate between top-level areas or modules in complex applications, featuring active states, tooltips, and badges.
- [Form Layout](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/form-layout) [Stable]: FormGrid, FormSection and FormActions. Responsive to the space they're in, not the screen.
- [Layout](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/index) [Stable]: Scaffolding primitives for responsive ERP application shells, navigation bars, and data panes.
- [Page Header](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/page-header) [Stable]: Breadcrumb, title, description and page actions, responsive by default.
- [Scroll Area](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/scroll-area) [Stable]: Native scrolling and keyboard support, styled scrollbars on every platform.
- [Separator](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/separator) [Stable]: Horizontal or vertical, announced as a separator.
- [Sidebar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/sidebar) [Stable]: Collapses to icons on desktop, slides in on mobile, with groups, badges, tooltips, nested submenus, and a keyboard shortcut.
- [Split Pane](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/split-pane) [Beta]: A list beside its detail, with a draggable, keyboard-resizable divider.
- [Top Bar](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/layout/top-bar) [Stable]: A responsive top navigation bar with slots for branding, search, and actions.
- [Accordion](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/accordion) [Stable]: One or many open sections, animated height, keyboard support.
- [Breadcrumb](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/breadcrumb) [Stable]: Links to each ancestor, a marked current page, and an ellipsis for long paths.
- [Collapsible](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/collapsible) [Stable]: An unstyled disclosure with a height animation, for "advanced options" and similar.
- [Navigation](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/index) [Stable]: Structures and controls that guide operators through multi-step journeys and hierarchical data.
- [Pagination](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/pagination) [Stable]: Controlled, translatable, with a stable width as you page.
- [Stepper](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/stepper) [Stable]: Horizontal or vertical, with descriptions, error states and clickable completed steps.
- [Tabs](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/navigation/tabs) [Stable]: Underline and pill styles with an animated indicator, horizontal or vertical.
- [Alert Dialog](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/alert-dialog) [Stable]: A dialog that can't be dismissed by clicking outside; the user must choose.
- [Command Palette](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/command-palette) [Stable]: A global command palette triggered by a keyboard shortcut (e.g. ⌘K) to quickly navigate and execute actions across the application.
- [Context Menu](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/context-menu) [Stable]: Same items as Dropdown Menu, positioned at the pointer.
- [Dialog](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/dialog) [Stable]: Focus trap, Escape and outside-click to close, nested dialogs, and five sizes.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/dropdown-menu) [Stable]: Groups, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, submenus and destructive actions.
- [Overlays](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/index) [Stable]: Layered interface elements that appear above base page content for focused interactions.
- [Popover](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/popover) [Stable]: Small forms, share panels and pickers that float next to their trigger.
- [Sheet](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/sheet) [Stable]: For filters, record details and edit forms next to a list. Slides from any side, RTL-aware.
- [Tooltip](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/overlays/tooltip) [Stable]: Names icon buttons and shows shortcuts. Shared delay across a toolbar.

## Widgets
- [App Switcher](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/app-switcher) [Stable]: A rich popover menu designed for the ECOSYSTEM module launcher, featuring grouped apps, descriptions, icons, and built-in search functionality.
- [Change Log](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/change-log) [Beta]: An audit trail with field-level before and after values, notes and day groups.
- [Widgets](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/index) [Stable]: High-level business components combining multiple primitives for enterprise ERP patterns.
- [Kanban Board](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/kanban-board) [Beta]: Pipelines, deals, tickets and approval stages, with drag and drop, keyboard moves and WIP limits.
- [Metric Card](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/metric-card) [Stable]: One component, seven designs: default, compact, sparkline, progress, comparison, split and accent.
- [Notification Bell](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/notification-bell) [Stable]: A rich popover component to display recent notifications, relative timestamps, and unread statuses, usually placed in the TopBar.
- [Permission Matrix](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/permission-matrix) [Beta]: Resources by actions, grouped by module, with row and column "all" toggles.
- [Sparkline](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/sparkline) [Stable]: Pure SVG, no chart library, server-safe.
- [User Menu](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/user-menu) [Stable]: A user profile button that opens a dropdown menu. Typically used in the top bar or sidebar footer to access profile settings and sign out.
- [Widget Card](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/widgets/widget-card) [Stable]: Header with title, count, actions and "View all", plus built-in loading, empty and error states.

## Charts
- [Cartesian Charts](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/charts/cartesian): Bar, Line, and Area charts for visualizing categorical data series.
- [Donut Chart](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/charts/donut): A Donut chart for visualizing proportions with a prominent center metric.
- [Charts](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/charts/index) [Stable]: Accessible, theme-aware charting primitives for financial summaries and inventory analytics.

## Patterns and Examples
- [Dashboard](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/examples/dashboard): An HRMS dashboard bringing together the Sidebar, AppRail, TopBar, MetricCards, charts, and dashboard widgets.
- [Setup Wizard](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/examples/setup-wizard): Brand panel, stepper, responsive form grid, locale selects, validation and a wizard footer.

- [Migration guides](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/resources/migration): Upgrade instructions and breaking change migrations between major versions.
- [Security](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/resources/security): Security practices, vulnerability reporting, and dependency auditing.
- [Versioning and support](https://innostes.com/ui/docs/resources/versioning): Semantic versioning policy, release lifecycle, and browser compatibility targets.
